checklist.title: Quick start
checklist.allDoneText: Your Procura workspace is set up.

welcome.title: Welcome to Procura!
welcome.description: We'll show you how it works. It takes 2 minutes. Follow the steps and you'll be ready to get started.

dashboard.title: Your main page
dashboard.description: Here you see everything that's going on: today's orders, pending invoices and important alerts.

suppliers.title: Your suppliers
suppliers.description: This is where you record your vendors and suppliers. When you place an order, you'll find them easily.

purchaseOrders.title: Purchase orders
purchaseOrders.description: Create an order for a supplier. You can also check whether the price is fair — the app compares market prices for you.

invoices.title: Your invoices
invoices.description: Create your invoices and email them to your clients. See who has paid and who still owes you.

products.title: Your products
products.description: List your products and their stock. When an item is about to run out, the app warns you before it's too late.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.description: Keep a copy of your agreements with suppliers. That way, if a price changes or there's a problem, you have written proof.

accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.description: See at a glance how much you've spent, what you've earned and whether your business is profitable.

aiAssistant.title: Your AI assistant
aiAssistant.description: Ask it a question in plain English — "Show me this month's invoices" or "Who is my best supplier?" — and it answers right away.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Add your shop name, your logo and your currency. This is also where you add other people from your team.

complete.title: Let's go!
complete.description: You've seen the essentials. Start by adding your shop name in the settings, then add your first supplier.

welcome.title: Welcome to ProcureGenius!
welcome.description: I'm Procury, your assistant. I'll walk you through the main features of the platform.

dashboard.title: The Dashboard
dashboard.description: This is your command center. You'll find an overview of your business, your alerts and your real-time statistics.

sidebar.title: The Sidebar
sidebar.description: Move easily between the app's modules. The modules shown depend on your configuration.

suppliers.title: Supplier Management
suppliers.description: Add and manage your suppliers. You can import from Excel, scan business cards and track their performance.

purchaseOrders.title: Purchase Orders
purchaseOrders.description: Create professional purchase orders in a few clicks. The AI can help you write the content.

invoices.title: Invoicing
invoices.description: Manage your client invoices. Email them and track payments in real time.

clients.title: Client Management
clients.description: Track your clients, their purchase history and their outstanding balances.

products.title: Products & Stock
products.description: Manage your product catalog, track your stock and get reorder alerts.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Customize your experience: company information, modules, printing, notifications and more.

aiAssistant.title: AI Assistant
aiAssistant.description: Your smart assistant can answer your questions, generate documents and help with your daily tasks.

complete.title: You're ready!
complete.description: You now know the basics of ProcureGenius. Feel free to explore, and restart this tutorial from the help menu if needed.
